title: Data Scientist - Growth
description:
ABOUT US

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $200M+ in ARR, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler.

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.

 - We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.

 - We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.

 - We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

As a Data Scientist for Growth at Legora, you'll build the data foundations that help our go-to-market teams make better decisions. You'll work end-to-end: connecting data from business systems, building reliable pipelines and dbt models, defining shared metrics, and answering questions about how we grow.

Your background may be in analytics engineering, data science or data engineering. You enjoy building data models that others can trust and reuse, and working closely with business teams to put that data to use.

You'll be based in our New York office, sitting with the Growth data team. Our go-to-market data is spread across a CRM, marketing automation and messaging platforms, sales engagement and call tools, support tooling, and our own product. Making those systems agree with each other, and with what customers actually do in Legora, is the heart of this job.

We're an AI-first data team. We believe the data function should be redesigned around what AI now makes possible, not retrofitted with it, and we want someone excited to help define what that looks like in practice.

We're a small, centralised team supporting the whole company. This seat is for Growth. Working closely with RevOps and the GTM teams, you'll help answer questions like:

 - Marketing: acquisition funnels, attribution and CAC, campaign measurement, and what actually moves enterprise legal buyers.

 - Sales & RevOps: what drives pipeline, sales performance and pilot-to-customer conversion.

 - Customer Success: account health, expansion and churn signals, and renewals in a category that didn't exist three years ago.

 - Lifecycle: getting modelled data back into the CRM and messaging tools, so teams act on it where they already work.


You'll partner directly with leaders across Marketing, Sales, RevOps and Customer Success who are data-fluent and eager to act on the wealth of data across our business. Your role is to bring structure to that data, uncover insights together, and build the tools and foundations that let them explore questions for themselves, shaping how we sell, where we spend, how we price, and which customers we in

title: Senior Applied AI Engineer, Federal
description:
ABOUT THREAD AI

Thread AI is focused on building an AI orchestration engine and is looking for dedicated individuals to join its growing team. Our goal is to make infrastructure simple for enterprises and public sector agencies seeking to get the most from AI and AI Agents.

Headquartered in New York, our growing team is a group of experts who have a track record of creating and executing against complex workflows and infrastructure.




ABOUT THE ROLE

You will work directly with federal customers to build AI workflows and integrations on Lemma. The work may start with data spread across several systems, a process full of manual handoffs, or a prototype that needs to become reliable enough for daily use. You will own the engineering through deployment and ongoing operation.

You will partner with an Applied AI Strategist who leads workflow discovery, customer coordination and adoption. You will own the architecture and production code, working with Thread’s product and engineering teams on technical review and platform changes. What you learn from customers will help determine what we build into Lemma next.

This is a senior individual contributor role with direct customer responsibility.

 - Work with users and customer engineers to define the problem, map system dependencies and agree on a first deployment.

 - Write production code that connects APIs, data sources and customer applications to Lemma. Build and test the workflows that use those connections.

 - Evaluate AI behavior against realistic examples. Define checks for output quality and reliability, and decide where a person needs to review or approve a result.

 - Deploy and operate the solution with the relevant engineering teams. Diagnose failures across application code, data, authentication and network boundaries.

 - Document technical decisions and operating procedures so customers and teammates can maintain what you ship.

 - Turn recurring customer needs into reusable integrations and product improvements. Work with core engineering when a solution belongs in the platform.

 - Help Growth assess technical feasibility and scope customer evaluations before delivery commitments are made.




WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - Five or more years of software engineering experience, or comparable evidence of independently delivering and operating production systems.

 - Strong programming skills in Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, Java or a similar language. You can explain your design choices, review code and debug unfamiliar systems.

 - Experience building APIs or integrations, working with databases and data pipelines, and using automated tests and deployment practices.

 - Hands-on experience with AI or ML applications, including evaluating their outputs and understanding where they fail.

 - Experience working directly with users or customer engineers to resolve incomplete requirements and make practical tradeoffs.

 - Clear communication about progress and technical risks, and the judgment to seek engineering review when needed.

Relevant backgrounds include product engineering, previous FDE work, and implementation engineering with substantial production coding. We welcome formal technical education and equivalent practical experience.

 - Delivering software for federal customers or other organizations with demanding security and operational requirements.

 - Measure adoption and results, and explain them clearly to users, program leaders and technical stakeholders.
